'''Mos Shuuta landing control''' monitored all starship traffic at the [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. A group of individuals managed to gain entry and successfully deactivated the landing clutches in [[Landing Bay Aurek]], despite the presence of a number of technicians and [[Brynn]], the overseer, to get off-planet and escape [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]].
